scope: Additional official NYC DCP ZAP/ULURP and LPC planning/preservation administrative milestone candidates from 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19, screened against data/manual_drops/architecture_milestones/architecture_milestones_2008_2026.json. These records are framed as administrative approvals, completions in official review workflow, acquisitions/dispositions, certifications, or LPC designations, not construction outcomes.

source_audits.license_and_attribution: NYC Open Data public dataset. Use City of New York Open Data Terms of Use and cite DCP; candidate stores factual row metadata and URLs only. Verify dataset-specific terms before redistributing bulk rows or geometry.
source_audits.coverage_years: Late 1970s through current monthly extract; queried 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19.
source_audits.update_frequency: Monthly according to NYC Open Data catalog metadata.
source_audits.geographic_scope_and_granularity: NYC land-use project/application row; parcel geometry requires joining ZAP BBL rows to a parcel source.
source_audits.reliability_assessment: Strong for administrative milestone dates and action identifiers; usable with caveats for project descriptions.
source_audits.required_caveats: Approval/completion in ZAP is an administrative land-use status, not construction completion, opening, occupancy, built form, or project impact.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use for official planning milestones where source_record_id is the project_id; keep ULURP/action numbers in source metadata and preserve date-field semantics.

source_audits.license_and_attribution: NYC Open Data public dataset. Use City of New York Open Data Terms of Use and cite DCP.
source_audits.coverage_years: Current ZAP project BBL associations; queried on 2026-05-19.
source_audits.update_frequency: Monthly according to NYC Open Data catalog metadata.
source_audits.geographic_scope_and_granularity: ZAP project to tax lot (BBL); validated fields indicate Geosupport validation.
source_audits.reliability_assessment: Strong when validated=true; reject or review manually when no validated BBL exists.
source_audits.required_caveats: BBLs may represent affected tax lots, not exact project footprint, phase boundary, building footprint, or future lot configuration.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use as the geometry bridge for ZAP rows; retain bbl_count and validation caveats.

source_audits.source_name: Primary Land Use Tax Lot Output (PLUTO)
source_audits.license_and_attribution: NYC Open Data public dataset. Cite DCP. Coordinates are DCP tax-lot points and should not be treated as surveyed project coordinates.
source_audits.update_frequency: Quarterly according to NYC Open Data catalog metadata.
source_audits.geographic_scope_and_granularity: NYC tax lot, with WGS84 latitude/longitude and BBL.
source_audits.reliability_assessment: Usable with caveats for representative map points.
source_audits.required_caveats: PLUTO coordinates are approximate tax-lot points and can differ from development footprints, multi-lot action areas, or future lot mergers/subdivisions.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use only as representative geometry for ZAP candidates unless project-specific official geometry is available.

source_audits.license_and_attribution: NYC Open Data public dataset. Use City of New York Open Data Terms of Use and cite LPC; candidate stores factual row metadata and URLs only. Verify dataset-specific terms before redistributing bulk geometry.
source_audits.coverage_years: LPC historic districts that have been calendared, heard, designated, or assigned LP numbers; queried 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19 by LPC dates.
source_audits.update_frequency: Updated as LPC GIS records change; catalog last observed update 2026-02-02.
source_audits.geographic_scope_and_granularity: Official historic district multipolygon boundary with LP number and action dates.
source_audits.reliability_assessment: Strong for district status, dates, and official boundary geometry.
source_audits.required_caveats: Historic district designation records are preservation administrative actions, not evidence of physical work, condition, occupancy, or neighborhood effects.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use for district-level preservation milestones; map with official polygons in production rather than representative candidate points.

source_audits.source_name: Designated and Calendared Buildings and Sites
source_audits.license_and_attribution: NYC Open Data public dataset. Use City of New York Open Data Terms of Use and cite LPC; candidate stores factual row metadata and URLs only.
source_audits.coverage_years: LPC items designated or under consideration; queried 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19 by LPC dates.
source_audits.update_frequency: Updated as LPC GIS records change; catalog last observed update 2026-02-02.
source_audits.geographic_scope_and_granularity: Official point per landmark/building/site record, with LP number, landmark type, status, calendaring, hearing, and designation dates.
source_audits.reliability_assessment: Strong for LPC administrative status and point geometry; use caution for count fields and non-current rows.
source_audits.required_caveats: Point geometry is not an interior footprint or district boundary. Existing individual-landmark records in the seed file should not be duplicated.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use for non-duplicate interior/scenic/calendaring milestones and for point geometry cross-checks.
